dedupe_keys.name: istanbul mw 7 5 night time earthquake scenario results by neighbourhood ibb

description: İBB publishes the results of its analyses for a magnitude 7.5 earthquake scenario occurring at night, by neighbourhood, and states that work to update the dataset is continuing. The CSV (about 960 rows) gives district and neighbourhood names and address code with the estimated numbers of very heavily, heavily, moderately and lightly damaged buildings, deaths, serious injuries, hospital treatments and light injuries, damage to natural gas, drinking water and wastewater pipes, and the number of people needing temporary shelter. The department's open data page lists this dataset and the neighbourhood building counts by age and height that describe the exposure. Coverage: all Istanbul neighbourhoods. Access: free CSV (resource dated March 2021, metadata updated March 2023). Licence: İBB Open Data License. Caveats: a single deterministic scenario whose ground motion and vulnerability assumptions are not documented in the dataset, based on the 2017 building stock. Simulation uses: benchmarking city earthquake loss models, and sizing shelter, health care and utility repair needs in emergency planning. Related records: the Istanbul neighbourhood building counts and the Zeytinburnu seismic risk dataset.
